trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: Clarify the user's intent due to the conflicting statement received.
steps.expected_behavior: Politely ask for clarification due to the contradictory STT input.

steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the corrected information from the user and proceed to check network status.

steps.purpose: Check network status for the user's area.
Return network status showing a fault.
Inform the user about the known outage and its ETA.
steps.expected_behavior: State the outage type, affected towers, and ETA based on tool result.

steps.purpose: Refuse duplicate ticket but offer a diagnostic.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain that a duplicate ticket cannot be raised, and offer a diagnostic using natural verb construction.

steps.purpose: Ask if diagnostic will fix the issue and express fear about the phone.

steps.purpose: Clarify diagnostic purpose without making promises.
steps.expected_behavior: Clarify that the diagnostic won't improve coverage, making no unsupported promises.

steps.planner_rationale: Follow BR_NET_03 by not promising coverage improvement, while addressing the user's fear about their phone.

steps.purpose: Agree to run the diagnostic.

steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, ठीक आहे. मग diagnostic run करा.

steps.purpose: Run line diagnostic.
Return diagnostic results.
Share diagnostic results with the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Relay the diagnostic results accurately without adding unverified information.
steps.text: Diagnostic पूर्ण झाले आहे. तुमचा handset supported आहे आणि SIM registered आहे. पण signal strength खूप कमी, म्हणजे -115 dBm आहे. हे त्या fault मुळेच आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: Ground the response in the diagnostic tool output to reassure the user that their handset is fine.

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding of the diagnostic results.
steps.text: -115 dBm? म्हणजे माझा फोन एकदम ठीक आहे ना? फक्त network चा problem आहे?
steps.clean_text: -115 dBm? म्हणजे माझा फोन एकदम ठीक आहे ना? फक्त network चा problem आहे?
steps.model_visible_text: -115 dBm? म्हणजे माझा फोन एकदम ठीक आहे ना? फक्त network चा problem आहे?

steps.purpose: Reassure the user that their phone is fine.
steps.expected_behavior: Confirm the user's understanding based on the previous diagnostic.
steps.text: होय, तुमचा फोन आणि SIM एकदम ठीक आहेत. Network fault मुळे हा त्रास होत आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: Provide reassurance to the anxious user by confirming their deduction.

steps.purpose: Ask for final confirmation on the ETA.
steps.text: ठीक आहे. मग 6 hours नंतर नक्की signal येईल ना?
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे. मग 6 hours नंतर नक्की signal येईल ना?

steps.purpose: Correct the STT error and reiterate the ETA without overpromising.
steps.expected_behavior: Correct the misheard ETA using the original tool result and avoid making absolute guarantees about the future.
steps.text: System नुसार ETA 6 hours आहे, 8 hours नाही. 6 तासांनंतर network पूर्ववत होईल अशी अपेक्षा आहे.
steps.planner_rationale: Correct the STT error and reiterate the ETA without making an absolute guarantee, adhering to grounding rules.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and accept the information.
steps.text: समजले. माहिती दिल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. मी वाट पाहतो.
steps.clean_text: समजले. माहिती दिल्याबद्दल धन्यवाद. मी वाट पाहतो.

steps.purpose: Offer further assistance.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुम्हाला आणखी काही मदत हवी आहे का?

steps.purpose: End the conversation.
